text:
This incident occurred on Friday, December 20, 2024. The dentist at this clinic was not punctual and did not respect their profession. When I arrived, there were no patients. I had an appointment with the dentist at 1 PM. I called to confirm with the counter, and the assistant said I could come. Upon arrival, there were no patients, and the assistant said the dentist had gone out for lunch (without informing the dentist that the staff had said patients could come in). I waited until 20 PM, a total of 50 minutes, before leaving. The counter staff argued incessantly without apologizing for their mistake and without calling the dentist to let them know the patient was waiting. The female dentist knew there were patients at 1 PM but didn't come in. I left without any apology from the three staff members. I do not recommend this clinic.
(The dentist was also a patient.)
I give it 5 stars. The service is excellent, friendly, and the clinic is clean. I took my novice monk to get his teeth extracted without any charge. Thank you very much.

text: The wait time was quite long, about an hour and a half. The appointment process wasn't very good. I would like to see improvements in the appointment system.

author_name: สุดารัตน์ ทองบริบูรณ์

text: “The management system is terrible and they don’t keep to time.” I went to wait to use the service. The staff said I could go in at 12:30. But when I went to use the service, the doctor went out to eat. I waited for an hour and the doctor still didn’t show any signs of coming in. The staff didn’t try to contact the doctor or inform me of anything. They just sat and talked, ate among themselves, and didn’t care about the patient. If it’s not convenient, the patient should be informed. When the patient started to get dissatisfied and asked questions, the staff didn’t apologize to the patient. They only said they had informed the doctor, but the doctor still left. I don’t understand the management. If it’s not convenient, the patient should be informed. They shouldn’t have to come in and wait for an hour like this. It’s very bad. Not impressed.

The teeth scaling is so expensive...1,000 baht! And I have to pay for social security myself. My colleague got it done elsewhere for 650 baht, and they were able to claim it through social security right away. Plus, they didn't have to wait long (the wait here was terrible). 😥😥 …
The tooth extraction was very gentle; I didn't even feel like it was over.

text: There's no social security claim process; you have to file it yourself. My dental appointment on Friday was difficult because the suctioning wasn't done properly; they made me bend my head down, making it hard to breathe. In short, I was unimpressed and won't go back.

Poor customer management, using an old tools, no a seat enough for a customers and you have to wait a very long time before you got a dental (at least 1 hr even you have an appointment), if you would like to do the dental, I'd suggest you to go away from here. this place is not much cheaper than other places that have a more modern and good customer services.

The wait was incredibly long! My appointment was at 1 PM, and I wouldn't be able to get my dental work done until 2 or 2:30 PM. I was so discouraged.
The medical team was very kind; they weren't harsh on the children at all and were very good at distracting them. I was very impressed.
